files.legend.sop:
@legend.plan.list core.legend
    namespace=plan.list
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    doc="Lists of the published schema w.list v3. State: lists ([{ id, name, sort, budget, tendered, currency, settled, items: [{ id, text, quantity, price, status }] }]), n (the last id)."
files.operations.sop:
@op.plan.list.make core.operation
    impl=make
    semantics=action
    action=list.make
    doc="The act make on w.list: what the user wants (one thing or several, with an amount) becomes entries of the shopping list the request means (listMeant); a list already paid for is settled, so a new purchase starts a new list."

@op.plan.list.change core.operation
    impl=change
    semantics=action
    action=list.change
    doc="The act change on a w.list list: the money tendered at the till (I pay 10 lei) or the budget (I start with 30 lei), in the currency said."

@op.plan.list.ask core.operation
    impl=ask
    semantics=action
    action=list.ask
    doc="The act ask on w.list: the price of a thing (mode price), whether the budget covers it (afford), the change (change: from the tendered money, or from the money and things the question names), what is left of the budget (left); every sum is the library's listSums, computed and never stored."

files.world.sop:
@world.plan.list core.world
    namespace=plan.list
    version=0.1.0
    legend=$legend.plan.list
    imports=world.core
    imports=world.lang.common
    imports=world.acts
    formalization=rules
    language=en
    status=fixture
    title="Lists and the shop"
    summary="shop with a list and pay"
    doc="A general world, not a tab (kids plan, ADR-011; Q18 K1, K6, L3): lists of the published world schema w.list v3 (a list with a sort, a budget, the money tendered at the till and a currency; entries with an object or food, a quantity and a price). What the user wants goes on the shopping list, what they pay is the list's tendered money, what they start with its budget; the total, the change, what is short and what is left are the library's listSums over the list, computed and never stored, and the list a request means when it names none is the library's listMeant. Its readings are the catalog's frames (w.lang.en shard list-frames, sets shop and wallet), generated by scripts/build-list-world.mjs; its money words the catalog's lexicon derived from k.units. Prices are not world knowledge: the price of an entry is the sample price list of this application (prices.sample.mjs, plan H1), until the user states one. Hand-built platform fixture, not produced by the C1 workflow."
